tw3.title: Balandur's Butter Knife (Baldur's Gate)
tw3.text: One of the items that may be found in cupboards or lockers is Balandur's Butter knife.

tw3.title: Silver Pantaloons (Baldur's Gate)
tw3.text: Another item which may be found in cupboards is Silver Pantaloons, which is an easter egg reference to a recurring easter egg throughout the Baldur's Gate trilogy.

tw3.title: CD PROJEKT RED weather vanes
tw3.text: Some of the weather vanes use the stylized cardinal logo used by CD PROJEKT RED.

tw3.title: Apology letter from "C. de P.R."
tw3.text: The letter of apology signed by "C. de P.R." serves as a thinly veiled apology from CD PROJEKT RED for the presence of bugs and glitches in the game.

tw3.title: Gottfried's Omni-opening Grimoire (GOG)
tw3.text: The book Gottfried's Omni-opening Grimoire (GOG) explains how to bypass the Defensive Regulatory Magicon (DRM). GOG is operated by GOG Ltd, a wholly owned subsidiary of CD PROJEKT RED, and delivers video games through its DRM-free digital platform.

tw3.title: Azure Wrath sword (Diablo)
tw3.text: As a reward for completing Contract: Mysterious Tracks, Geralt will receive the silver sword Azure Wrath, which is a reference to "Azurewrath", an angelic blade once wielded by the fallen angel Izual that appears as a unique/legendary weapon in Diablo II and III.

tw3.title: "Fresh Meat!" butcher (Diablo)
tw3.text: When you first enter the butchers house in Fyresdal, he will shout "Fresh Meat", just like The Butcher does in each Diablo game upon encountering him for the first time.

tw3.title: "I'll rip off your melon" (Duke Nukem)
tw3.text: When fighting bandits sometimes they will say "I'll rip off your melon and shit down your neck".

tw3.title: "War never changes" (Fallout)
tw3.text: Peasants sometimes remark "War - it just never changes." and some elves in Scoia'tael camps sometimes say "War... War changes everything" both are references to the famous quote used in the intros to Fallout.

tw3.title: Companion Cube room (Portal)
tw3.text: At some point during the quest Turn and Face the Strange, you can enter a portal only to enter a small room with nothing but a bloodied crate in the center and a chest containing a Cake nearby.

tw3.title: "Power Overwhelming" trophy (StarCraft)
tw3.text: In the trophy list, the trophy for unlocking places of power is called "Power Overwhelming", in reference to the original Starcraft Archon quote and cheat of the same name.

tw3.title: Arrow in the knee (Skyrim)
tw3.text: The game makes several references to the infamous Skyrim line "I used to be an adventurer like you, then I took an arrow in the knee."

tw3.title: "No lollygagging" (Skyrim)
tw3.text: Occasionally, guards in Novigrad will say "No lollygagging", a phrase also spoken by guards in Skyrim.

tw3.title: "Tomb raider" corpse (Tomb Raider)
tw3.text: During the quest The Great Escape you will find a corpse. Upon examining it Geralt will say "Heheh. Tomb raider. Seemed this one liked elven stuff".

tw3.title: Leeroy's Dead notice (World of Warcraft)
tw3.text: In the, on Plegmunds Bridge's notice board is an announcement, Leeroy's Dead. It references a popular World of Warcraft youtube video and later meme in which a WoW player runs into a fight after shouting out their name and gets them and their whole team killed.

tw3.title: Therazane (World of Warcraft)
tw3.text: In the side quest Contract: Doors Slamming Shut, the name of the elemental, Therazane, is a reference to the elemental lord of Earth in World of Warcraft called .

skyrim.title: Silver-Blood ring (Game of Thrones)
skyrim.text: When the Dragonborn completes No One Escapes Cidhna Mine in the favor of Thonar Silver-Blood, he apologizes and gives the Dragonborn his family ring, saying that the Silver-Bloods pay their debts. This may be a reference to the unofficial motto of the Lannister house, "A Lannister always pays his debts."

skyrim.title: The Headless Horseman
skyrim.text: At night along roads you have a chance of encountering a spectral horseman without a head galloping along at full tilt. He carries an axe on his back, which is likely a reference to Washington Irving's The Legend of Sleepy Hollow. If you follow him, he eventually takes you to Hamvir's Rest, where there are several skeletons, and a leveled draugr to fight and a Master chest.

skyrim.title: "Seek the wumpus" (Hunt the Wumpus)
skyrim.text: If he is a follower and you enter a cave, Belrand will say, "When I was a boy, my friends and I used to play 'seek the wumpus' in caves much like this," a reference to the classic video game Hunt the Wumpus.

skyrim.title: The Gildergreen (Lord of the Rings)
skyrim.text: In Whiterun, the giant tree there is called the Gildergreen. It is grown from the Eldergleam, the oldest living thing in Skyrim, but it is dying. This is similar to the Gondorian capital of Minas Tirith in Lord of the Rings: Return of the King, where the legendary White Tree faces a similar fate.

skyrim.title: Whiterun looks like Edoras (Lord of the Rings)
skyrim.text: The city of Whiterun greatly resembles Edoras, the capital of Rohan; both cities are built atop a bluff, with the palace at the top of the hill and have a horse portrayed on their banner.

skyrim.title: "My precious" Hagraven (Lord of the Rings)
skyrim.text: During "A Night to Remember," one of the tasks is to obtain a wedding ring from a Hagraven named Moira, who will say, "My precious" while trying to get the ring from her, referencing Gollum.

skyrim.title: Farengar Secret-Fire (Gandalf)
skyrim.text: Faerengar Secret-Fire's name is a direct reference to Gandalf's declaration in Moria, "I am a servant of the Secret Fire."

skyrim.title: Notched Pickaxe (Minecraft)
skyrim.text: The Notched Pickaxe is a reference to "Notch," the creator of Minecraft. As a pickaxe, it is used for mining and it also has an enchantment that boosts Smithing, Skyrim's method of crafting. It is located just below the very top of The Throat of the World. Climb your way up the remaining part of the mountain by jumping and you should arrive there.

skyrim.title: Pac-Man cheese scene
skyrim.text: In Endon's House in Markarth, look for a shelf in the back of the room with Sliced Goat Cheese, a row of Garlic, and some Glow Dust arranged to look like a scene from Pac-Man.

skyrim.title: GLaDOS potato (Portal 2)
skyrim.text: In Skuldafn, one of the fireplaces contains a potato, a boiled creme treat, and three pieces of charcoal placed in such a way that it resembles Portal 2's character GLaDOS in her potato battery form.

skyrim.title: "Hit the one in the middle!" (Rocky)
skyrim.text: A generic piece of dialogue sometimes uttered by male drunks and bandits during a brawl is "Remember... hit the one in the middle!" This is the advice given by Paulie in Rocky IV to help Rocky overcome double vision, which can be caused by both drunkenness and head trauma.

skyrim.title: Seven beds in Blackreach (Snow White)
skyrim.text: Inside Blackreach, you will find a building called the War Quarters. Inside these quarters, one will find one room with seven small beds placed in a circle around a lantern. This may be a reference to Snow White and the Seven Dwarves. Opposite of the bedroom is a hallway and at the end another bedroom, where a much larger double-bed is found.

skyrim.title: Temba Wide-Arm (Star Trek)
skyrim.text: In the village of Ivarstead, there is a woman named Temba Wide-Arm. This is a reference to the Star Trek: The Next Generation episode Darmok, where one of the often-repeated phrases is "Temba, his arms wide."

skyrim.title: Upside-down skeleton and glowing sword (Star Wars)
skyrim.text: Inside of Bleakcoast Cave (Eastern Winterhold), there is a skeleton hanging upside down from the ceiling. Below the skeleton is a glowing greatsword. This is a reference to Star Wars Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back when Luke Skywalker was caught on Hoth and hung from the cavern ceiling. The sword below represents his lightsaber.

skyrim.title: Three Billy Goats Gruff bridge
skyrim.text: On your way to Hag Rock Redoubt, there is a bridge with a dead Troll underneath. If it is your first time visiting, you will witness two goats meeting a third at the end of the bridge then running off together. This is a reference to the fairy tale, Three Billy Goats Gruff, where a troll is defeated by a trio of goats. A similar reference was made in Oblivion.

skyrim.title: William Tell's apple
skyrim.text: Upon entering the first hall of Swindler's Den, there is a practice dummy with a red apple perched atop its head. This is a reference to the Swiss story of William Tell, who had to shoot an apple off of his son's head.

skyrim.title: M'aiq the Liar
skyrim.text: M'aiq reappears in . He appeared in and, as an Easter Egg Basket of sorts for developers to comment on some of the game features that were removed, added, or were/are planned for the series as well as other RPG gaming community related remarks.

skyrim.title: The sweetroll
skyrim.text: The Sweetroll can be found throughout Skyrim as a normal food item, and is sometimes placed in strange locations.

skyrim.title: "Someone stole your sweetroll"
skyrim.text: At times, a hold guard will remark "Let me guess, someone stole your sweetroll."

rdr1.title: "A Cowboy Without a Name" grave
rdr1.text: At the Coot's Chapel church, there is a gravestone with the label "A Cowboy Without a Name", a clear reference to Clint Eastwood's Man with No Name.

rdr1.title: Harrison Cherry's grave
rdr1.text: In the graveyard beside Blackwater chapel, there is a grave of a man named Harrison Cherry who allegedly died in 1968. This is believed to be a reference to George Harrison of The Beatles, which is backed by the facts that he owned a cherry guitar and yet another grave marked at Odd Fellow's Rest cemetery reads "He'll never dance with another.", a clear nod to the Beatles song "I Saw Her Standing There".

rdr1.title: Clinton Underwood's grave
rdr1.text: On a tombstone besides the Blackwater Chapel, the name Clinton Underwood can be seen. This is most likely a parody on the famous western actor Clint Eastwood.

rdr1.title: "Wake me... if something interesting happens" grave
rdr1.text: On a tombstone beside Blackwater Chapel is inscribed the phrase, "Wake me... if something interesting happens.". This could be a reference to Undead Nightmare in which zombies can come out of graves or a reference from the popular HALO game series where the protagonist says "wake me... if you need me" before going into cryogenic sleep.

rdr1.title: Emma Crawford's grave
rdr1.text: One of the graves is marked "Emma Crawford", a woman who had to be reburied into a graveyard after her coffin slid down a hill (where she wanted to be buried).

rdr1.title: "The Devil has got into that beast" altar
rdr1.text: In the Tumbleweed church, the words "THE DEVIL HAS GOT INTO THAT BEAST" are scrawled on the top of the altar. Speculation on fan forums say it refers to the scrawny black horse that often spawns around Tumbleweed, oddly hitched when there is no one around, while others think this is a reference to the Dark Horse.

tlou.title: Photo of Naughty Dog team
tlou.text: At the start of the "Hometown" chapter, in Sarah's room, one of the posters on the wall depict members of the Naughty Dog development team, the developers of The Last of Us series.

tlou.title: Dawn of the Wolf
tlou.text: A film series whose poster can be initially seen in Sarah's room, but appears all over the game in several different variations including posters, billboard advertisements, and DVD cases. The films are a parody of, a vampire-themed romance film series based on the .

tlou.title: console
tlou.text: During the chapter "Hometown", when the player goes down to the living room of Joel and Sarah's house, there is a PlayStation 3 console on the shelf under the television set. Another one is found in Larry's TV & Stereo, an electronics store Ellie passes through after escaping David into the blizzard during the "Lakeside Resort" chapter.

tlou.title: Uncharted 13: A Lush Movie
tlou.text: Throughout the game, including Left Behind, there are a number of newspapers on the ground called The Daily Metro with a headline stating "Uncharted 13: A Lush Movie — as Drake." Drake refers to Nathan Drake from the Uncharted series, also developed by Naughty Dog.

tlou.title: The Walking Dead house
tlou.text: One of the houses that Bill, Joel and Ellie travel through looks almost identical to the layout of the house from the beginning of the 2012 episodic video game by .

tlou.title: Uncharted theme song
tlou.text: When Ellie learns to whistle during the "Pittsburgh" chapter, the tune she whistles is vaguely similar to the "Nate's Theme" track from the Uncharted series.

tlou.title: Jack Sullivinsky
tlou.text: When Joel and Ellie are separated in the basement of the Hotel Grand, Joel must find a keycard to escape. The owner of the keycard is named Jack Sullivinsky, a surname that is strikingly close to Victor Sullivan's, Drake's companion from the Uncharted series.

tlou.title: JAK Company poster
tlou.text: Near the mob attack note, the player can find a poster about employee rights. This poster is made by the JAK Company, which is a reference to the Jak and Daxter series, also developed by Naughty Dog. The poster also includes a phone number, 1-800-555-TLOU, and the URL for The Last of Us website.

tlou.title: Nathan Drake, Jak and Daxter plush toys
tlou.text: Right after meeting Henry and Sam, Joel will be able to enter a child's room in Serenity Apartments. Jak and Daxter plush toys can be found on a dresser and a Nathan Drake plush toy can be found on the bed.

tlou.title: Naughty Dog mousepad
tlou.text: Joel can find a blue mousepad with the Naughty Dog logo across it on computer desks in several locations. In Pittsburgh, there is one in the same shiv room of Serenity Apartments, as well as Spenzür Architecture, the office Henry and Sam have taken temporary residence in. There is also one in a second-story bedroom of the ranch house during "Tommy's Dam".

tlou.title: O'Sullivan's Irish Pub
tlou.text: A restaurant bar found near the bridge in Pittsburgh, O'Sullivan's Pub, bears a striking resemblance to the pub from the opening of Uncharted 3: Drake's Deception. The name "O'Sullivan's" is also a reference to Victor Sullivan.

tlou.title: Java Jak
tlou.text: A coffee cart called "Java Jak" can be found right outside the O'Sullivan's Irish Pub in Pittsburgh. This is a reference to the Jak and Daxter series. Another one can be found during the chapter "Fun and Games" of Left Behind, outside of Raja's Arcade while Ellie and Riley explore the Liberty Gardens mall.

tlou.title: Infected inside, do not open
tlou.text: Right after escaping the sewers, the group find "Warning: Infected inside, do not open" written on the wall. This is a reference to the first episode of the TV adaptation of, in which the protagonist finds a sign saying "Don't open, dead inside" on a door.

tlou.title: Faithful Dog
tlou.text: After escaping from David during the "Lakeside Resort" chapter, Ellie will enter a pet store called "Faithful Dog". This is a reference to Naughty Dog.

tlou.title: Uncharted 2 phurba
tlou.text: After Ellie drops down into the kitchen of Todd's Steakhouse, move into a back office where there will be a notice board. Here, a piece of paper can be seen which displays the phurba dagger from Uncharted 2: Among Thieves.

tlou.title: NDI sticker
tlou.text: During the chapter "Bus Depot", Joel can find an NDI sticker on the wall of a bathroom stall in the Logan James Bus Station, which is a reference to Naughty Dog. The sticker is also identical to the ones seen in Uncharted 3: Drake's Deception.

tlou.title: Eye chart
tlou.text: In the Firefly's lab at Saint Mary's Hospital, there are eye charts with messages that can be read from left to right. One of them says "RUN YOU R NEARLY THERE DON'T QUIT!!"

tlou.title: Uncharted Nathan Drake costume
tlou.text: During the chapter "Mallrats" of Left Behind, in the Spooky Town Costume Emporium in the Liberty Gardens mall, Ellie can find packaged Nathan Drake costumes from Uncharted 2: Among Thieves.

tlou.title: Raja's Arcade
tlou.text: During the chapter "Fun and Games", Ellie and Riley come across an arcade named "Raja's Arcade" in the Liberty Gardens mall. The name "Raja" is a reference to the siblings Eddy and Rika Raja from the Uncharted series. Raja's Arcade also makes an appearance in The Last of Us: American Dreams.

tlou2.title: Uncharted artifact
tlou2.text: The antique ring found in Ellie's Seattle Day 1 chapter is Francis Drake's ring from the Uncharted series.

tlou2.title: Strange relics
tlou2.text: The strange relic found by Abby in her Seattle Day 1 chapter is a reference to the Precursor orb from the Jak and Daxter series. The Precursor orb also appears as an artifact of the same name in the Uncharted series.

tlou2.title: Naughty Dog staff cats
tlou2.text: Photos of Naughty Dog staff members' pets are seen in the game, such as sound implementer Christopher Walasek's cat appearing on "missing cat" posters around Seattle, and game designer Pete Ellis's cat Reginald, who appears on a calendar in Ellie's Seattle Day 2 chapter.

gta5.title: Alien Egg
gta5.text: There is a hidden Alien Egg in the game files that can be spawned using third-party trainers. The egg glows in the dark when spawned. The Alien Egg was eventually added to GTA Online in the Gunrunning update as supplies that the player can steal. To trigger the mission, the player must complete 600 resupply missions and start a new one between 21:00 and 23:00. If all conditions are met, the game may randomly begin th
gta5.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V

gta5.title: Alien in the Ice
gta5.text: In Ludendorff, North Yankton, underneath the train bridge the crew passes in the Prologue, there is a frozen creek. The player is able to drive down an embankment and onto the ice, where an alien is visible, frozen underneath it. It can also be found during the mission Bury the Hatchet.
gta5.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V

gta5.title: Collector's Edition Black Light Map
gta5.text: Using a black light/UV light on the blueprint map that comes with the Collector's Edition reveals markings, map legends, secrets and text. Most of the things that appear are pointing towards the existence of UFOs. Three of the collectible Spaceship Parts are also shown in the map.
gta5.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V

gta5.title: UFOs
gta5.text: Multiple UFOs can be seen, most of them only after 100% Completion is obtained. Three appear in the sky and one appears underwater.
gta5.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V

gta5.title: Ghost of Jolene Cranley-Evans
gta5.text: Between 23:00 and 0:00, a female ghost appears on the eastern peak of Mount Gordo. It doesn't react to any actions the player takes towards it unless they get too close, in which case the ghost will then disappear until the player backs off. During the time it is present, the word "JOCK" appears written in blood below where the ghost is floating, and a distressed female voice can occasionally be heard. In an article
gta5.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V

gta5.title: Bigfoot vs Beast
gta5.text: After eating all 27 Peyote Plants, golden ones will appear; one in a different location for each day of the week. When eaten, they will turn the player into Bigfoot. If consumed in order (from Sunday to Saturday), when eating the final plant, a dead animal will be lying nearby, along with the body of the Sasquatch Hunter from The Last One. Growling will cause a howl to sound from the distance, to which the player mus
gta5.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V

gta5.title: Thermal Bigfoot
gta5.text: In the mission Predator, Michael must use a sniper rifle fitted with a thermal scope to find the O'Neil brothers in the woods at night. If the player zooms in on the thermal heat dot in the bottom right, it appears to be the Sasquatch standing still. Shooting it does nothing and it abruptly disappears within a few seconds of being spotted.
gta5.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V

gta5.title: The Chupacabra
gta5.text: Chupacabra Street is named after the Chupacabra, a Latin American cryptid.
gta5.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V

gta5.title: Beta map
gta5.text: A beta map of Los Santos can be found inside Los Santos Transit stations and the Vanilla Unicorn's employee area.
gta5.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V

gta5.title: Big O juice stand
gta5.text: In both Vinewood Hills and Grapeseed, a Big O juice stand can be found with a large orange ball on top of it. Shooting or walking into the ball will cause it to detach and roll around. It has very little weight and can be moved easily.
gta5.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V

gta5.title: Black Cellphones
gta5.text: Dialing 1-999-367-3767 will call an unlisted contact called "Black Cellphones", after which a small explosion will occur over the player's head and their phone color will be changed to black.
gta5.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V

gta5.title: Bodhi
gta5.text: The Bodhi is named after Bodhi Ogg, the son of Trevor Philips' voice and motion capture actor Steven Ogg.
gta5.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V

gta5.title: California
gta5.text: There is a wrecked pickup truck bed in Stab City with a real-life California license plate. As seen in alpha build screenshots published by Rockstar North developers, this is left over from when California license plates were used as placeholders for the San Andreas license plates. A sign in Sandy Shores advertises a business known as "Salton Sea Real Estate". This is likely an oversight, as the Salton Sea is the rea
gta5.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V

gta5.title: CNT Billboards
gta5.text: Along Elgin Avenue in Vinewood Hills is a CNT billboard made to look like a TV, with its "screen" being breakable glass. It is possible to both launch vehicles and skydive through it. A nearly identical billboard can be found near the Los Santos International Airport; however, the glass on this one cannot be broken.
gta5.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V

gta5.title: Confederate Battle Flag
gta5.text: A Confederate States of America battle flag used to be hung at Braddock Farm and The Range. The latter's was replaced with an American flag in the enhanced edition, while the former's was covered by a sign reading, "Trespassers will be shot! Survivors will be shot again!" in 2017, at the same time as GTA Onlines Doomsday Heist update. If the sign is somehow removed, the battle flag can still be seen underneath.
gta5.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V

gta5.title: Face on Mount Chiliad
gta5.text: On the Xbox 360 and PS3 versions, the face of Rockstar Leeds artist David Dixon (internally named with his initials "dd_signature") could be seen on the side of Mount Chiliad. In the enhanced editions, this face was replaced with a drawing of a rooster shaped to look like a penis.
gta5.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V

gta5.title: Graffiti defacement/messages
gta5.text: Various instances of defacing graffiti and messages can be found around the map, some of which only appear as the story progresses. Along Interstate 2 in Downtown Los Santos is graffiti featuring the text "This is broken - Can I return it?" and a drawing of the American flag. This exact same text and drawing can also be seen on a banner along the train tracks in Rancho. On a wall of the Vespucci Beach Recreation Cent
gta5.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V

gta5.title: Greentooth
gta5.text: At the north end of the Mount Chiliad train tunnel, a green smiley face with sharp teeth - known as Greentooth - can be seen spraypainted on the wall. This is an inside joke between videogame developers.
gta5.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V

gta5.title: Hot Wheels
gta5.text: The name of the auto service business Ruedas De Fuego translates to "Fire Wheels" in English. This is possibly a reference to the Hot Wheels toy car brand.
gta5.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V

gta5.title: Hunting Pictures
gta5.text: During the Hunting side-activity, Trevor is instructed by Cletus Ewing to send him photographs of the animals he shoots. It is possible, however, to send them to other contacts instead. Their responses range from simply commenting on the picture, to utter confusion or disgust. Certain contacts have specific responses while others share randomized, generic ones. It is also possible to send Cletus a photograph of a dea
gta5.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V

gta5.title: HVYMTL
gta5.text: Combining the names of HVY and MTL - two heavy-duty vehicle manufacturers - spells out HVYMTL, a disemvoweling of "heavy metal".
gta5.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V

gta5.title: Mount Chiliad Mural
gta5.text: A mysterious mural inside the tramway station atop Mount Chiliad includes a drawing of what appears to be a jetpack, leading to speculation that such a device might be hidden somewhere on the map, though it was later revealed that it was an unimplemented idea from the game developers. Although data files for a jetpack were present in the game, the vehicle itself was later scrapped for unknown reasons, though a simila
gta5.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V

gta5.title: Real Brands
gta5.text: In the original versions of the game, on the Lucky Plucker menu boards, stickers for the real life beverages, Sprite (drink), Barq's, and Fanta could be seen. These were removed in the enhanced edition.
gta5.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V

gta5.title: Red Ring Of Death
gta5.text: A donut advertised on the Bleeter page for Rusty Brown's Ring Donuts is called the Red Ring of Death donut. This is a reference to the infamous Xbox 360 error nicknamed the Xbox 360 technical problems.
gta5.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V

gta5.title: Rockstar Games/Scotland
gta5.text: contains numerous references to Rockstar Games and Rockstar North, the developers of the Grand Theft Auto series and the games' primary development team, respectively.
gta5.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V

gta5.title: Snowman
gta5.text: In East Los Santos, a Snowman is visible inside a room of the Fridgit warehouse, behind some boxes. The room cannot be entered, but can be seen through a gap in the door and fired into.
gta5.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V

gta5.title: The Infinity Killer
gta5.text: Throughout Blaine County and the Grand Senora Desert, various traces of serial killer Merle Abrahams - also known as "The Infinity Killer" due to his obsession with the number 8 and infinity - can be found. Following the clues can lead to the locations of his victims' bodies. In Sandy Shores, a newspaper clipping can be found that claims Abrahams passed away in 2004 while awaiting trial for the abduction, torture, an
gta5.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V

gta5.title: "This Does Not Exist"
gta5.text: There is a small floating white square in the sky and small white cube far beneath the map that contain the text "this does not exist"; the latter is unable to be seen in-game without mods. These are likely developer oversights.
gta5.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V

gta5.title: Underwater Wrecks
gta5.text: Surrounding the map are underwater wrecks, ranging between planes, ships, military vehicles, a submarine, a Diving chamber, and even a UFO (see above). Amongst some of the wreckages, the player can find weapons, armor, health packs, and briefcases containing money.
gta5.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V

gta5.title: Whale Skeleton
gta5.text: A whale skeleton can be found underwater, just off of Banham Canyon.
gta5.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V

gta5.title: Wrecked Tank
gta5.text: A wrecked T-34 can be found at Rogers Salvage & Scrap.
gta5.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA V

gtasa.title: 3ds Max Screenshot
gtasa.text: Inside one of the guard booths (the one that is near the spawn location of Leviathan and Raindance) within the Easter Bay Airport, there is a computer running 3ds Max (Autodesk tool used by Rockstar North to create the models for the RenderWare-based titles), showing a screenshot of the interior props found in the Las Venturas City Planning Department.
gtasa.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA San Andreas

gtasa.title: Catalina's Past
gtasa.text: Near Catalina's cabin, there are three graves and a shovel, suggesting she may have murdered and buried past lovers prior to meeting Carl Johnson.
gtasa.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA San Andreas

gtasa.title: Gant Bridge Facts
gtasa.text: At the visitor center below Katie Zhan's House, there is a list of facts about the Gant Bridge, one of which reads "Takes up a staggering 1.27mb of disk space." In, the sign is updated to reflect the size of the new version of the bridge, reading that it "Takes up a staggering 38.9mb of disk space."
gtasa.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA San Andreas

gtasa.title: Hidden Sign
gtasa.text: On top of the Gant Bridge, there is a sign that reads "There are no easter eggs up here. Go away."
gtasa.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA San Andreas

gtasa.title: Mass Grave
gtasa.text: Near Area 69, there is a hole that is filled with six body bags.
gtasa.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA San Andreas

gtasa.title: Scott Wilson's Grave
gtasa.text: In the Palomino Creek graveyard, there is a grave which reads "R.I.P Scott Wilson", referring to the Rockstar North level designer who worked on the countryside areas of the game.
gtasa.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA San Andreas

gtasa.title: Caligula's Palace Model
gtasa.text: On the top floor of the Las Venturas City Planning Department, a model of Caligula's Palace can be found with a Rockstar logo on it.
gtasa.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA San Andreas

gtasa.title: Clothing
gtasa.text: Some of the clothing that the player wears, as well the suitcase at the start of the game that CJ holds while in the airport, and more items have the Rockstar Games logo on them.
gtasa.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA San Andreas

gtasa.title: Parachute
gtasa.text: The parachute has a small Rockstar North logo on the back.
gtasa.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA San Andreas

gtasa.title: San Fierro Tower
gtasa.text: If viewing the San Fierro Tower at night from the south, the player can see the Rockstar Games logo being shown as the lighting of the building.
gtasa.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA San Andreas

gtasa.title: Stars
gtasa.text: At night, if the player looks up in the sky, there are stars that form the letter R in reference to the Rockstar Games logo, with a larger star representing the star from the logo.
gtasa.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA San Andreas

gtasa.title: Zero RC
gtasa.text: The kites and sailboats inside Zero RC have the Rockstar logo on them.
gtasa.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA San Andreas

gtasa.title: Carcer Gas
gtasa.text: Carcer Gas cylinders are from Carcer City, the setting of Manhunt.
gtasa.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA San Andreas

gtasa.title: Doormat
gtasa.text: Inside Big Smoke's Crack Palace, there is a doormat that reads "Not Welcome Rockstar North" with the Rockstar North logo in the center.
gtasa.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA San Andreas

gtasa.title: Hydra
gtasa.text: Part of the text on the side of the Hydra features the letters "DMA"; this is likely a reference to Rockstar North since the company was formerly known as DMA Design. DMA is also a play on United States Marine Corps squadrons that use the McDonnell Douglas AV-8B Harrier II (VMA).
gtasa.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA San Andreas

gtasa.title: Manhunt Blueprint
gtasa.text: On the top floor of the Las Venturas City Planning Department, the blueprints of from Manhunt can be seen on the wall.
gtasa.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA San Andreas

gtasa.title: Mugshots
gtasa.text: Inside Las Venturas Police Headquarters, there are pictures of James Earl Cash and members of from Rockstar North's Manhunt.
gtasa.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA San Andreas

gtasa.title: Northstar Rock
gtasa.text: Northstar Rock is a reference to Rockstar North.
gtasa.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA San Andreas

gtasa.title: State of Emergency
gtasa.text: The cheat code "Chaos Mode" could reference Rockstar and VIS Entertainment's 2001 game, State of Emergency (video game). Chaos Mode was one of the playable game modes in this game.
gtasa.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA San Andreas

gtasa.title: Window Pane
gtasa.text: The Gasso gas station in Dillimore has a sign on its window reading "Max Pane- Bulletproof Glass". This is a reference to Remedy Entertainment's Max Payne franchise, published by Rockstar Games.
gtasa.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA San Andreas

gtasa.title: Carl's surfboard
gtasa.text: Carl's wardrobe contains a surfboard with an image of Vice City on it.
gtasa.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA San Andreas

gtasa.title: Denise's poster
gtasa.text: In Denise Robinson's house, there is a poster of Grand Theft Auto: Vice City's box art on her bedroom wall.
gtasa.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA San Andreas

gtasa.title: Half-Life
gtasa.text: In the mission Black Project, the player can spot a crowbar on a table in a lab. This is a reference to Valve's 1998 game Half-Life (video game).
gtasa.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA San Andreas

gtasa.title: Postal
gtasa.text: In the mission Black Project, after the player enters the base and the alarm is raised, one of the voice announcements says "Personnel reminded that running in corridors whilst holding scissors is not permitted". This is a possible reference to the video game company Running with Scissors, best known for its Postal (video game) games, which are considered by some to be "GTA Clones".
gtasa.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA San Andreas

gtasa.title: Resident Evil
gtasa.text: The Zombotech Corporation is most likely a reference to the Umbrella Corporation from the Resident Evil (series) series. Also, based on a diagram on the wall, there appears to be a large underground facility reminiscent of from the Resident Evil film.
gtasa.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA San Andreas

gtasa.title: Back to the Future
gtasa.text: The Trip Skip icon features the side profile of the Deluxo, a car mostly inspired by the DeLorean DMC-12 that is otherwise absent from the game. This is a reference to the Back to the Future franchise, which features a DeLorean-based time machine.
gtasa.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA San Andreas

gtasa.title: James Bond
gtasa.text: The finance company named J. Bond Bail Bonds is a reference to James Bond.
gtasa.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA San Andreas

gtasa.title: Terminator
gtasa.text: The scene in the mission Just Business featuring a Packer jumping off a surface road in slow motion into a storm drain channel, which Big Smoke and CJ are using to escape, is a nod to a similar scene in the 1991 film Terminator 2: Judgment Day, where a large tow-truck executes a similar stunt as it is in pursuit of John Connor.
gtasa.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA San Andreas

gtasa.title: The Big Lebowski
gtasa.text: When Cesar asks CJ if he'd like to make some money, CJ responds "Does the pope shit in the woods?", a malapropism coined by The Dude in The Big Lebowski.
gtasa.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA San Andreas

gtasa.title: The Karate Kid
gtasa.text: The Cobra Marital Arts gym is probably a reference to the Cobra Martial Arts gym in the movie The Karate Kid.
gtasa.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA San Andreas

gta4.title: AC/DC
gta4.text: In the graveyard behind the Meadows Park Church, there is a tomb or cenotaph with the epitaph below: Roll of Honor "War of the Deadline" 1869-1869 "for those about to build...... we salute you" . This is a reference to the album titled "For Those About to Rock We Salute You" by AC/DC.
gta4.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA IV

gta4.title: Burger Shot Disclaimer
gta4.text: Under the menu of Burger Shot, the player can see the disclaimer "This Burger may kill you! We can't be held responsible".
gta4.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA IV

gta4.title: Clean Hands, Clean Conscience
gta4.text: On the paper-towel dispenser in Cluckin' Bell restaurants, a sign reads "Clean Hands, Clean Conscience". This is likely a reference to the metaphor of .
gta4.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA IV

gta4.title: Cluckin' Bell Cash Register
gta4.text: On the cash register in Cluckin' Bell restaurants, the player can see that the text on it reads "Holy Shit", "Veg Crap", "Medium, Extra Medium, Medium XL", "Ask CJ", "Launch Missiles", "Space Lazer" etc.
gta4.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA IV

gta4.title: Dinosaur Fossils
gta4.text: In The Libertonian, the plaque describing the Tyrannosaurus Rex and Triceratops appears to read: "This big bastard took a few days to knock up because it had to be done by the sole hand of a prop artist. But alas, and feast your eyes on this 21000 poly maniac. Trex right up your arse. How do you like them apples?".
gta4.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA IV

gta4.title: Faustin Blood Trails
gta4.text: In the backyard of Mikhail Faustin's home, there are two blood trails on the ground.
gta4.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA IV

gta4.title: Grant's Tomb Epitaph
gta4.text: In Middle Park West, the epitaph of Grant's Tomb is "We Love To Fight" instead of "Let Us Have Peace". (In-game website mention of Ulysses S. Grant)
gta4.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA IV

gta4.title: Mr. Tasty GTA IV Theme
gta4.text: While driving the Mr. Tasty, the player is able to trigger songs to play by clicking the horn. One of these songs is the theme song of GTA IV. While this song is playing, call ZiT and they will text back with "ZiT! Spotted GTA IV Theme". This activates a cheat that gives the player health, armor and ammo, but this will also block some achievements and trophies in the game.
gta4.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA IV

gta4.title: Outlook Park Rules
gta4.text: At the entrance of Outlook Park, the player can see a sign with the rules: "no eating, no drinking, no dogs, no children, no ball games, no hotdogs, no running".
gta4.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA IV

gta4.title: Packie's Brain-Box
gta4.text: If the player positions the camera in such a way that they are able to see inside Patrick McReary's head, a small cube with Packie's balaclava texture from "Three Leaf Clover" can be seen.
gta4.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA IV

gta4.title: Police Brutality
gta4.text: Inside the East Holland Police Station, it is possible to see three cops and someone on the ground. Another incident of police brutality can be found on the northern beach of Boulevard, Bohan.
gta4.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA IV

gta4.title: Prison Chart
gta4.text: In the missions done for Gerald McReary while he is in prison, a chart can be seen behind Gerald during the cutscenes for each mission. There are several names written on it, all of which are puns, including "Isaac Hunt" (I's a c*nt), "Seymour Fani" (see more fanny), "Richard Head" (dick head), and "Phil Mcreavis" (fill my crevice).
gta4.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA IV

gta4.title: Statue of Happiness
gta4.text: The Statue of Happiness' face bears a striking resemblance to former U.S. Secretary of State Hillary Clinton. This resemblance, along with the cup of coffee in her right hand, may be a reference to the Hot Coffee controversy which Clinton was involved in. The southern door has a sign which reads "No Hidden Content This Way". This is similar to The Hidden Sign in and the sign on top of the Gant Bridge in . Within the
gta4.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA IV

gta4.title: Traffic Cone Statue
gta4.text: Inside the courtyard of the Civilization Committee Complex in Hatton Gardens, there is a statue with a traffic cone on its head.
gta4.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA IV

gta4.title: TW@ Photocopier
gta4.text: At all TW@ internet cafes, behind the cashier's desk, and also inside various vehicle dealerships, the screen of the Kakagawa Power Ultra 3000 Pro photocopier reads "ERROR Unleash ninja guru lol". This can only be seen through the scope of a Sniper Rifle.
gta4.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA IV

gta4.title: Veggie Wings
gta4.text: The Cluckin' Bell new "Veggie Wings" feature a disclaimer on the menu, stating that they "may contain meat".
gta4.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA IV

gta4.title: 3D Universe Character Graffiti
gta4.text: On the staircases in most apartment blocks in the game, the player may spot some graffiti referring to past protagonists from the (Claude, Tommy, Carl (CJ), Toni, and Vic) that suggests they have died, though it is likely metaphorical as the 3D Universe canon is over so they won't be seen again. The only on-screen death of a protagonist from this era is Victor Vance. The graffiti is intended to serve as "a little jok
gta4.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA IV

gta4.title: Babies Overnight
gta4.text: One of the in-game radio advertisements is for an online service called Babies Overnight. The tagline at the end and the background music are evocative of the commercial in GTA III for Petsovernight.com.
gta4.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA IV

gta4.title: Chiliad8888
gta4.text: Niko can receive an email from Chiliad8888, which calls the recipient "Pilgrim", makes many spiritually- and philosophically-charged (and anti-government) comments, ends with "Feel the Truth, Live the Freedom", and links to whattheydonotwantyoutoknow.com. On this website there is a discussion topic titled, "Jump to a new level of Spirituality" posted by "Trooth". This discussion thread includes more philosophical tho
gta4.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA IV

gta4.title: Claude's Outfit
gta4.text: When Playboy X is killed, it is possible to go to his apartment and open the wardrobe to get a change of clothes that look like the clothing of Claude, the protagonist of GTA III.
gta4.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA IV

gta4.title: GTA San Andreas Myths
gta4.text: There is a Liberty Tree article that talks about urban myths in Liberty City. This could be referring to the myths that were created around GTA San Andreas.
gta4.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA IV

gta4.title: Miniature Golf Course Miniatures
gta4.text: In the miniature golf course Funland amusement park, several miniatures are re-used from previous GTA games: (from left to right) Jefferson Towers (GTA San Andreas); windmill (several different place in GTA San Andreas); "The Big Pecker" (GTA San Andreas); Ocean View Hotel (GTA Vice City); Vice City Lighthouse (GTA Vice City).
gta4.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA IV

gta4.title: Street Artist's Concept Art
gta4.text: On Happiness Island, in front of the entrance to the statue, it is possible to find a street-artist's easel/display stand with several pictures. These pictures are all concept works of many previous GTA characters. The easel can also be seen in south-central Algonquin, very close to where Hossan's random encounter takes place and in front of The Libertonian.
gta4.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA IV

gta4.title: Donald Love
gta4.text: The newspaper used to promote appears as an Easter egg in newspaper vending machines. The newspaper headline "Love's Hate Relationship With Taxes" depicting Donald Love would later become a recurring Easter egg in the HD Universe.
gta4.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA IV

gta4.title: Gruppe Sechs
gta4.text: The Securicars are owned by the Gruppe Sechs security firm (also seen in GTA III, and ), although in GTA IV and GTA V, the name is rendered as "Gruppe 6". "Sechs" is the German word for Six and "Gruppe" means group, thereby creating the phrase "group sex".
gta4.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA IV

gta4.title: GTAs Musicians
gta4.text: CDs from pre-GTA IV musicians are found in different places in GTA IV: Madd Dogg - "Still Madd and OG Loc - "Str8 from tha Street", both rappers in GTA San Andreas. Some of the in-game ringtones that can be downloaded from Vipluxuryringtones.com are based on songs from GTA Liberty City Stories: Rudy LaFontaine - "Funk in Time" and Sunshine Shine - "Mine Until Monday can both be heard on Lips 106, and Purser - "Feel t
gta4.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA IV

gta4.title: Love Fist
gta4.text: In Star Junction, there is a sign for Love Fist. Love Fist was featured in GTA Vice City, and was also on a sign in GTA San Andreas and GTA Liberty City Stories.
gta4.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA IV

gta4.title: Halo
gta4.text: The animated TV show Republican Space Rangers spoofs the Halo (series) series, as it features space marines wearing a green armor that resembles the MJOLNIR armor as seen in Halo. In one scene, the Rangers fly their spaceship through a ring that resembles a HALO ring.
gta4.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA IV

gta4.title: Manhunt
gta4.text: In the amusement park in Broker, there are blue/purple hippo statues, just like the ones from Manhunt. The achievement/trophy for completing all the Most Wanted side missions is called Manhunt. On the website Yourmexicandoctor.com, two drugs first seen in Manhunt 2 ( and ) are shown to be for sale.
gta4.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA IV

gta4.title: Mario
gta4.text: On the wall in the arcade Videogeddon in Chinatown, there are several sprites on the wall resembling those of old games. One of the sprites is a blond man, with a long mustache and plumber-like black clothes. The sprite resembles Mario from the Super Mario Brothers series.
gta4.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA IV

gta4.title: Mortal Kombat
gta4.text: The achievement/trophy "Finish Him" may be a reference to the Mortal Kombat series of video games.
gta4.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA IV

gta4.title: "If I was that big chimp, I would climb it too."
gta4.text: If the player goes on a Heli Ride with Brucie, upon reaching the Rotterdam Tower, Brucie might say "If I was that big chimp, I would climb it too." This is a reference to King Kong.
gta4.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA IV

gta4.title: Concrete Jungle
gta4.text: Named after the hit song by Bob Marley. The song is also in the official soundtrack. Also, if the mission for some reason fails and is restarted, Little Jacob will, on the drive back to the Homebrew Café, refer to the underground of Liberty City as "a messy concrete jungle".
gta4.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA IV

gta4.title: Diamonds Are a Girl's Best Friend
gta4.text: Reference to the movie Gentlemen Prefer Blondes (1953 film) with Marilyn Monroe.
gta4.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA IV

gtavc.title: Cement Shoes
gtavc.text: Between the shore of Downtown and the nearest peninsula of to the west of Leaf Links, atop gigatic underwater rocks, one can find a drowned man 'wearing' cement 'shoes'. Another can be found at Washinton Beach. close to where one of the target's of Autocide is cruising on a Tropic. Both men share the same design of a short, overweight man stripped to underwear. Based on skin remaining on their corpses, it can be infe
gtavc.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City

gtavc.title: Easter Egg
gtavc.text: In Downtown Vice City, near the Vice City News building, there is a window on a building where the player can jump through and find the "Easter Egg Room", which is a brown Easter egg on top of a pedestal.
gtavc.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City

gtavc.title: Steve Mulholland's Grave
gtavc.text: In the window of Funeraria Romero, there is a grave stone which reads "Steven Mulholland R.i.P", a reference to Rockstar North map artist Steven Mulholland. This also features in Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas.
gtavc.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City

gtavc.title: Submarine
gtavc.text: A submarine can be seen in the water off the north coast of North Point Mall.
gtavc.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City

gtavc.title: Airplanes
gtavc.text: The tailfins of some airplanes have the Rockstar logo.
gtavc.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City

gtavc.title: Gravestones
gtavc.text: In Funeraria Romero, there are numerous gravestones and pictures with the Rockstar logo on them.
gtavc.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City

gtavc.title: Sewer Graffiti
gtavc.text: In Little Haiti, there is a sewer system which, on the walls, shows the Rockstar logo several times.
gtavc.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City

gtavc.title: Store
gtavc.text: Located in Ocean Beach, there is a shop called Rockster Video Games. The name is an obvious reference to Rockstar Games. It also includes artwork of 8-ball and various GTA characters.
gtavc.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City

gtavc.title: Swimming Pool
gtavc.text: A pool shaped like the Rockstar Games logo can be seen on Starfish Island.
gtavc.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City

gtavc.title: Claude
gtavc.text: In Tommy Vercetti's room at the Ocean View Hotel, there is a poster featuring Grand Theft Auto III protagonist Claude.
gtavc.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City

gtavc.title: Loading Screen Music
gtavc.text: The Commodore 64 is referenced in the Rockstar North loading screen. Not only this, but the music in the background is the Grand Theft Auto theme song, Joyride, by Da Shootaz. It is remixed to sound like that of the Commodore 64.
gtavc.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City

gtavc.title: Mission Instructions
gtavc.text: Avery Carrington's instructions to Tommy Vercetti during the mission "Two Bit Hit" are almost exactly the same as those given by Donald Love to Claude during the mission "Waka-Gashira Wipeout!" in GTA III. Carrington instructs Love to write down what he is saying to Tommy: "Now, nothing brings down real estate prices quicker than a good old-fashioned gang war - 'cept maybe a disaster, like a biblical plague or someth
gtavc.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City

gtavc.title: Driver
gtavc.text: Dick Tanner, from the mission "Autocide", is a reference to Tanner of the Driver (series) series.
gtavc.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City

gtavc.title: The Getaway
gtavc.text: Marcus Hammond, Franco Carter and Charlie Dilson, also from the mission "Autocide", are references to Mark Hammond, Frank Carter and Charlie Jolson from The Getaway (video game).
gtavc.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City

gtavc.title: True Crime: Streets of L.A.
gtavc.text: Nick Kong is a reference to Nick Kang from True Crime: Streets of L.A..
gtavc.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City

gtavc.title: Bloody Apartment
gtavc.text: Inside Apartment 3c, a large amount of blood and a chainsaw can be found inside the bathroom, an obvious reference to the famous crime movie Scarface (film).
gtavc.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City

gtavc.title: Fake Moon Landing
gtavc.text: In the film studio, in one of the recording rooms, is a remake of the lunar lander. This is a reference to the conspiracy spuriously alleging that the Lunar landing was filmed on Earth at a soundstage and thus faked, supposedly to upstage the Soviets (with their competing lunar program) or as a convenient distraction from the increasingly unpopular Vietnam War.
gtavc.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City

gtavc.title: Indiana's Plane
gtavc.text: The Skimmer plane is similar to a seaplane used in the beginning of Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark. During the mission "Dildo Dodo", it is mentioned that the seaplane was used in "some old indie movie".
gtavc.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City

gtavc.title: Mobsters
gtavc.text: Portraits of Frank Sinatra, Bruno Hauptmann and the Mafia are kept at Saint Mark's Bistro, with copies of the real life newspaper Daily News.
gtavc.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City

gtavc.title: Pablo Escobar
gtavc.text: The Escobar International Airport is named after Pablo Escobar, the real life Tony Montana and probably the biggest drug lord at his time. At the peak of his career, he was smuggling around fifteen tons of cocaine into the United States per day.
gtavc.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City

gtavc.title: Vera Stretz
gtavc.text: In the Definitive Edition, a framed newspaper referencing the 1936 trial of Vera Stretz can be seen on the wall behind Sonny Forelli in the opening cutscene inside Marco's Bistro.
gtavc.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City

gtavc.title: Alex Shrub
gtavc.text: Alex Shrub may be based on former American president George H. W. Bush and former Florida governor Jeb Bush. A shrub and a bush are both plants, whilst the nickname "Shrub" was given to George W Bush by author Molly Ivins. Shrub's voice is also similar to that of George H. W. Bush.
gtavc.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City

gtavc.title: Steve Scott
gtavc.text: Steve Scott is a parody of Steven Spielberg, as are the films he directs at the InterGlobal Studios lot.
gtavc.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City

gtavc.title: Keep Your Friends Close...
gtavc.text: The events of "Keep Your Friends Close..." is similar to the ending of Scarface, involving a shootout in the protagonists mansion, although Tommy Vercetti survives the shootout, while Tony Montana is killed.
gtavc.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City

gtavc.title: Publicity Tour
gtavc.text: The mission "Publicity Tour", where Tommy Vercetti drives a limousine whilst Love Fist deactivates a bomb in the back, is based on the film Speed (1994 film) where Officer Jack Traven is forced to drive a bus at over 50 mph to stop a bomb from detonating.
gtavc.page: Secrets and Easter Eggs in GTA Vice City

cp2077.title: Call of Duty reference
cp2077.text: Herold Lowe has the upper body of an orange Robot R Mk.2 suspended from his stall that mimics his crossed-arms pose, which resembles QR-M5TR from Infinite Warfare.

cp2077.title: Contra reference
cp2077.text: Trauma Drama, the arcade mini-game added in Patch 2.0, has similar gameplay to the Contra series.

cp2077.title: Cyberpunk 2020 reference
cp2077.text: A shard found in the game, "Cyberpunk 2020 Rulebook", is a reference to the original Cyberpunk 2020 pen-and-paper RPG.

cp2077.title: Dark Souls reference
cp2077.text: The pose "V for Victory" in the Photo Mode is a reference to the famous gesture "Praise the Sun" from the Dark Souls series.

cp2077.title: Death Stranding reference
cp2077.text: A capsule containing a human infant, identical to Bridge Baby in Death Stranding series, can be found in the side job The Hunt.

cp2077.title: Doom reference
cp2077.text: The BFC 9000 weapon added in Patch 2.1 is a reference to the BFG 9000 weapon from the Doom series.

cp2077.title: Fallout reference
cp2077.text: Archived Conversation: Albert Cole and Gary Epps contains several references to the entire Fallout series.

cp2077.title: Hideo Kojima reference
cp2077.text: Hideo Kojima makes a cameo during the Act 1 mission The Heist. He can be seen in the bar of Konpeki Plaza.

cp2077.title: Mike Pondsmith reference
cp2077.text: There are several references to Mike Pondsmith within 2077 itself, such as Pondsmith Street in Japantown. Maximum Mike, the DJ of radio station 107.3 Morro Rock Radio, is voiced by Pondsmith.

cp2077.title: Super Mario Bros. reference
cp2077.text: The shard "Hello gonk!" is a reference to the Super Mario Bros. series, and it's "The princess is in another castle".

cp2077.title: System Shock reference
cp2077.text: The image of the Sublimation perk in the Intelligence tree is similar to SHODAN from the System Shock games.

cp2077.title: Wolfenstein 3D reference
cp2077.text: Arasaka Tower 3D, the arcade mini-game added in Patch 2.0, has similar gameplay and HUD to Wolfenstein 3D.

cp2077.title: Army of Darkness reference
cp2077.text: The icon for the Like A Feather perk in the Body tree bears Bruce Campell's likeness in his role as Ash Williams in the film Army of Darkness (1992), also paying homage to his iconic "This... is my BOOMSTICK" scene in the same film.

cp2077.title: Attack on Titan reference
cp2077.text: The pose "Scout Salute" in the Photo Mode is a reference to the "Dedicate your Heart!" (Japanese: 心臓を捧げよ!, Hepburn: Shinzō o Sasageyo!) salute used by the Survey Corps in the Attack on Titan franchise.

cp2077.title: Back to the Future reference
cp2077.text: The icon for the Chipware Connoisseur perk in the Technical Ability tree bears Christopher Lloyd's likeness in his role as Doctor Emett Brown in the film Back to the Future (1995), also paying homage to a famous shot of him in the same film.

cp2077.title: Back to the Future Part II reference
cp2077.text: Added with Patch 2.2 as a Mini-World Story, a shard can be found during a game of chicken between two cars taking place at the docks in Northside, Watson. The characters mentioned in the shard are references to the characters Marty McFly, Jennifer Parker and Douglas J. Needles from the film Back to the Future Part II (1989).

cp2077.title: The Big Lebowski reference
cp2077.text: During the main job Disasterpiece, if you choose to browse the Net via terminal, in the "Jig-Jig Street" section; there will be a paragraph titled "The Dude", the same nickname the main protagonist of the film The Big Lebowski (1998) has, with the text saying: "Good times, chill vibes. No rush, no stress, no drama.

cp2077.title: Black Hawk Down / Dawn of the Dead reference
cp2077.text: There is an advertisement in the game about a film titled "Black Hawk Dawn of the Dead", one of which can be seen during the main job Love Like Fire. This is a reference to the films Black Hawk Down (2001) and Dawn of the Dead (2004).

cp2077.title: Brokeback Mountain reference
cp2077.text: A shard titled "Archived Conversation: Jack and Dennis" can be found during an Assault in Progress in the Badlands; the corpses nearby are wearing cowboy hats, reminiscent of the main characters Ennis Del Mar and Jack Twist in the film Brokeback Mountain (2005). The character's names are also Jack and Dennis, a subtle reference.

cp2077.title: Brother 2 reference
cp2077.text: During the gig Fixer, Merc, Soldier, Spy, V can hear a Russian merc quoting (non-verbatim) the famous "power is in truth" speech from the film Brother 2 (2000).

cp2077.title: Catch Me If You Can reference
cp2077.text: A shard titled "Hello gonk!" has one of the lines: "Catch me if you can xD", which might be a reference to the film Catch Me If You Can (2002).

cp2077.title: Children of Men reference
cp2077.text: A shard titled "Archived Conversation: Theo Faron and The Human Project" has a conversation about a plan to smuggle a woman and her daughter out to the sea, similar to the events in the film Children of Men (2006) in which Theo (the protagonist) has to smuggle a pregnant woman named Kee to "The Human Project," an offshore science team working on a cure for infertility.

cp2077.title: Cowboy Bebop reference
cp2077.text: During the Suspected Organized Crime Activity: Desperate Sons-of-Bitches in Rancho Coronado, the names Faye Spiegel, Spike Valentine, Jet White, Vicious Volaju, and Elektra Ovirova can be seen in a computer message.

cp2077.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon reference
cp2077.text: The pose "Crouching Punk, Hidden Samurai" in the Photo Mode is a reference to the film Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon (2000).

cp2077.title: Czterej pancerni i pies reference
cp2077.text: The e-mail attachment V receives from Panam after completing the side job Queen of the Highway is a reference to the 1960s Polish series Czterej pancerni i pies (English: Four Tank-Men and a Dog). Codename "Rudy" depicted on the vehicle was also used by the original Polish panzer crew during World War II which was a T-34 tank.

cp2077.title: Demolition Man reference
cp2077.text: In V's apartment, three seashells are set on a shelf next to the toilet, where three seashells are described as the future replacement of traditional toilet paper, but their specific use and function is never elaborated upon in the film Demolition Man (1993).

cp2077.title: The Departed reference
cp2077.text: A shard titled "Archived Conversation: Thomas Costigan and NCPD Sgt. Martin Dignam" is a reference to Leonardo DiCaprio's character William M. "Billy" Costigan Jr. and Mark Whalberg's character Sergeant Sean Dignam from the film The Departed (2006).

cp2077.title: The Devil's Advocate reference
cp2077.text: The pose "Devil's Advocate" in the Photo Mode is a reference to the film The Devil's Advocate (1997) starring Keanu Reeves and Al Pacino.

cp2077.title: Dirty Harry reference
cp2077.text: In the side job "Following the River", when V plays an Augmented Reality game with River's niece and nephew, the name of the nephew's character is police officer Henry Callahan, a wordplay on Harry Callahan from the Dirty Harry franchise. Like in the franchise, Callahan is also a lone wolf cop who is a rebel.

cp2077.title: The Dukes of Hazzard reference
cp2077.text: The name and paint scheme of the car Quadra Type-66 "Jen Rowley" are references to the General Lee car from the series The Dukes of Hazzard.

hzd.title: Decima
hzd.text: Both HADES and the Eclipse cultists use the symbol of a black circle with a red line intersecting it from below; this image is also used as the logo for the Decima game engine, which was developed by Guerrilla Games for use in the Horizon and Killzone series.
hzd.page: List of Easter eggs in the Horizon series

hzd.title: Death Stranding
hzd.text: The Stranded Items found across the game are references to Death Stranding, which was developed by Kojima Productions in close collaboration with Guerrilla Games. The inventory icons of the Stranded Items are a silhouette of Ludens, Kojima Productions' mascot.
hzd.page: List of Easter eggs in the Horizon series

hzd.title: Jazz Jackrabbit
hzd.text: East of the Bandit Camp at Devil's Thirst, directly next to Metal Flower Mark I (D), there are rabbits identified by the Focus as Jazz and Jack, in reference to the Jazz Jackrabbit series. Guerrilla Games was founded in part by members of Orange Games, a studio which developed Jazz Jackrabbit 2.
hzd.page: List of Easter eggs in the Horizon series

hzd.title: Killzone
hzd.text: The Ancient Vessel "KZ" depicts a Helghast Assault Infantry soldier, as seen on the European box art of Killzone 3, another title developed by Guerrilla Games. Vessel 07 KZ.png|"KZ" Ancient Vessel Killzone 3 Cover.JPG|Killzone 3 box artwork
hzd.page: List of Easter eggs in the Horizon series

hzd.title: Metroid
hzd.text: ]] During the cutscene The Good News, the silhouette of a Metroid larva can briefly be seen as part of an evolutionary tree.
hzd.page: List of Easter eggs in the Horizon series

hzd.title: RIGS: Mechanized Combat League
hzd.text: The Vantage Point Denver Stadium contains a logo for RIGS: Mechanized Combat League, a VR game produced by Guerrilla's sister studio, Guerrilla Cambridge.
hzd.page: List of Easter eggs in the Horizon series

hfw.title: Daniel Wewerinke
hfw.text: In the datapoint VIP Key!, the names Hans and Elise were chosen by Senior Game Designer Daniel Wewerinke, as they are the names of his parents. Additionally, the code 2204, given in this datapoint, is a reference to his mother's birthday. Codes used in other ruins were similarly derived from the birthdates of Wewerinke's family members.
hfw.page: List of Easter eggs in the Horizon series

hfw.title: Donkey Kong Country
hfw.text: Within Rebel Camp: First Forge, a derailed mine cart can be found surrounded by bananas and barrels - one containing a red baseball cap - referencing Donkey Kong Country.
hfw.page: List of Easter eggs in the Horizon series

hfw.title: Dennis Micka
hfw.text: The names of the 4 optional Cauldrons (MU, IOTA, CHI, and KAPPA) spell out the acronym "MICK" when ordered by ascending difficulty level. World designer Dennis Micka chose these names to spell out his surname, Micka, but a fifth planned cauldron (presumably named ALPHA) was removed from the game during development, leaving the acronym incomplete.
hfw.page: List of Easter eggs in the Horizon series

hfw.title: Excalibur
hfw.text: Southeast of Riverhymn, a sword can be found protruding from a stone, referencing the mythical Excalibur of Arthurian legend.
hfw.page: List of Easter eggs in the Horizon series

hfw.title: Ghost of Tsushima
hfw.text: Southwest of Thornmarsh, an invincible Red Fox can be found which will lead the player towards a shrine in the form of a fox sculpture. This is a reference to the Inari shrines found in Ghost of Tsushima.
hfw.page: List of Easter eggs in the Horizon series

hfw.title: God of War
hfw.text: The War Totem collectables each reference characters from the 2018 God of War, and are found in locations referencing the main characters of the game.
hfw.page: List of Easter eggs in the Horizon series

hfw.title: Killzone
hfw.text: Inside LATOPOLIS, a rack can be found filled with guns resembling the LSR44 Spoor, the primary weapon used throughout the Killzone Shadow Fall campaign.
hfw.page: List of Easter eggs in the Horizon series

hfw.title: The Legend of Zelda
hfw.text: In Cauldrons MU, IOTA, CHI, and KAPPA, sealed doors can be found with Triforce symbols above them. These doors can be opened by pressing the sequence for Zelda's Lullaby (◀▲▶◀▲▶) on the controller's D-pad, each leading to a small room with additional loot. Upon opening the door, Aloy's dialogue contains the phrases "hey, listen" and "it's dangerous to go alone", both notable quotations from the Zelda series.
hfw.page: List of Easter eggs in the Horizon series

hfw.title: Patrick Munnik memorial
hfw.text: To the northwest of Thornmarsh, on an island connected to the mainland by a sandbar, a memorial can be found honoring Patrick Munnik, lead producer of Horizon Zero Dawn. Upon reaching the memorial site, Aloy will sit on a woven mat with a scenic view of the Isle of Spires and read from a note eulogizing a deceased friend.
hfw.page: List of Easter eggs in the Horizon series

hfw.title: Ukraine graffiti
hfw.text: In the Relic Ruins at Restless Weald, a tiny artwork of the Guerilla Games logo can be found next to an image of a heart and the Ukrainian flag, on a railcar.
hfw.page: List of Easter eggs in the Horizon series

hfw.title: Ukraine message
hfw.text: A small message can be found carved into rock, allegedly written by a member of Guerilla:
